name: browser-workflow
description: Runs your Browser Workflow automations in your own Chrome, and keeps what they produce on your computer.
long_description: Browser Workflow lets you describe a task on a website and have Claude build an automation for it. This extension is the part that runs on your computer: it opens the pages in Chrome, does what the workflow says, and saves the screenshots and collected data in a folder on your computer. It connects to the Browser Workflow connector you added in Claude; the first time, Claude links the two with one button.

tools.name: bridge_status
tools.description: Shows whether this computer is linked to Browser Workflow and connected, and what to do when it is not.
